candidates.classification: Previously observed public-construction invariant gap, assessed as a possible strengthening rather than a demonstrated product defect.
candidates.trace: RightsValidity::try_new rejects an end before its start, but both fields are public, allowing a caller to construct an inverted value directly. PermissionGrant::try_new validates grant lifecycle and consumed receipt provenance but does not revalidate this value. For a hypothetical active grant with from=100 and through=90, every minute below 100 is NotYetValid and every minute at or above 100 is Expired, assuming the exact question matches; contains also has no valid minute. Thus the selected active assessment does not grant access from that inverted window.
candidates.caller_evidence: An exact-spelling tracked-source search under crates finds declarations and references in the rights owner and its test module, with no separate production call site in those results. This bounded text search does not rule out aliases, external consumers, generated code or future use. The value has no Serde or SpacetimeDB derives in the inspected type; no untrusted wire admission is claimed.
candidates.safeguards_and_limits: Reusable/consumed lifecycle and revoked/receipt revision safeguards are independent. Consumed exact-provenance replay is intentionally checked before active-window validity, and the fail-closed claim applies only to Active state, not replay semantics. Whether invalid windows should be unrepresentable or allowed as unavailable state is an API policy question. No native invalid grant, transaction, player impact, or bypass of an existing authorization was established.
candidates.connected_repair: If a valid inclusive interval is intended as an invariant of RightsValidity, make construction checked and prevent unchecked field mutation while providing the needed read access; alternatively, validate at each native admission if representable invalid observations are intentional. Preserve inclusive boundaries, unbounded ends, expired/not-yet-valid distinctions and exact consumed replay behavior. Review future native grant construction and reconcile with PL13-198 before deduplication.
candidates.later_acceptance: After separate implementation and product-validation authorization, cover equal endpoints, unbounded end, before/after boundaries, inverted construction, grant lifecycle and idempotent replay without permitting an active invalid window.
